script.label: Baseline
script.instruction: Engine idling, charger OFF, every load OFF. Hands off everything.

script.label: Headlights (low beam) OFF
script.instruction: Switch it OFF again: Headlights (low beam).

script.label: High beam ON
script.instruction: Switch the HIGH BEAM on (headlights stay on).

script.label: High beam OFF
script.instruction: Switch it OFF again: High beam.

script.label: Rear defrost OFF
script.instruction: Switch it OFF again: Rear defrost.

script.label: Blower fan MAX ON
script.instruction: Set the blower to MAXIMUM (A/C may be on or off; keep it the same for the whole test).

script.label: Blower fan MAX OFF
script.instruction: Switch it OFF again: Blower fan MAX.

script.label: Heated seats HIGH ON
script.instruction: Switch BOTH heated seats to HIGH.

script.label: Heated seats HIGH OFF
script.instruction: Switch it OFF again: Heated seats HIGH.

script.label: Brake pedal held ON
script.instruction: Press and HOLD the brake pedal firmly (car in P, handbrake on).

script.label: Brake pedal held OFF
script.instruction: Switch it OFF again: Brake pedal held.

script.label: ALL loads ON
script.instruction: Headlights + rear defrost + blower MAX + both heated seats ON together (release the brake pedal).

script.label: All OFF (recovery)
script.instruction: Everything OFF. Hands off; recording ends at 3:00.

note: read-only recording; TAG column = script step; Time = seconds since recorder start
